selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of a pruritic rash starting after initiation of a new immunotherapy regimen, along with biopsy findings showing superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils, are most consistent with an immune-related adverse event (irAE) of immunotherapy, which encompasses reactions to both pembrolizumab and ipilimumab.

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatitis
rejected.why: While ipilimumab could be a cause, the broader category of irAE better explains the findings given the combination therapy.
